title: Salus: A Practical Trusted Execution Environment for CPU-FPGA Heterogeneous Cloud Platforms
problem: CPU-FPGA heterogeneous cloud platforms lack adequate trusted execution environments for protecting sensitive data. Existing standalone FPGA TEE solutions have limitations when deployed on commercial-off-the-shelf cloud FPGA services where CPU and FPGA are tightly integrated.
motivation: CPU-FPGA heterogeneous architectures are increasingly used in cloud environments for acceleration, requiring secure protection of sensitive data processed across both components.
method: Salus leverages a TEE-enabled CPU enclave on the host to protect and attest FPGA bitstreams. It repurposes commercial-off-the-shelf FPGA bitstream utilities in a security-enhanced manner and adopts proposed security-enhanced FPGA IP to enable practical bitstream protection and attestation without major infrastructure modifications.
key_novelty: Using a CPU TEE enclave to protect and attest FPGA bitstreams by repurposing existing COTS FPGA bitstream utilities in a novel security-enhanced design.
contributions: Identifies requirements and challenges for FPGA TEE design in cloud environments
Proposes practical CPU-TEE based approach to protect FPGA bitstreams in heterogeneous architectures
Demonstrates novel repurposing of COTS FPGA bitstream utilities for security operations
Introduces security-enhanced FPGA IP design requiring minimal deployment effort
limitations: Specific performance overhead, scalability limits, and end-to-end security guarantees are not discussed in the abstract.
primary_theme: trusted FPGA execution for cloud heterogeneous systems
